tools.description: Add units of a product to one of your carts. Pass variant_id when the product has combinations (see get_product). Stock is re-validated on every call; the answer is the cart read back after the add.

variant_id.description:
The combination to add; required when the product
has combinations, omitted for a plain product.

lines.description: The cart's lines, in cart order.

shipping_yen.description: Shipping fee in yen (free at the store's threshold).

subtotal_yen.description: Sum of purchasable line totals, in yen.

total_yen.description: Grand total in yen: subtotal plus shipping.

tools.description: Freeze one of your carts, with a delivery address, into an order draft and get its approval URL. Requires an API key with the orders:write scope. A person opens the URL, checks the frozen lines, address and totals, picks a payment method and pays in the browser — this tool never places the order itself, and any later change to the cart voids the draft. Repeating the call with the same idempotency_key returns the same draft, but the approval URL is shown only on the first, creating call.

email.description: Contact email the order confirms to.

address.description: The delivery address the order will ship to.

idempotency_key.description:
A caller-chosen key: repeating a create with the
same key returns the same draft instead of drafting
twice. At most 128 characters.

tools.name: create_order_draft

McpDraftLine.description:
One line of a draft, from its frozen snapshot: what
the approval page listed at creation (or, after the
pay click, in the final binding).

unit_price_yen.description: Unit price in integer yen, tax included.

variant_label.description: Combination label; empty for a plain product.

approval_url.description: The browser approval URL (create answer only).

expires_at.description: When the approval window closes, RFC 3339.

lines.description: The draft's lines, from its snapshot.

order_id.description: The placed order's id, once the draft is consumed.

subtotal_yen.description: Sum of line totals in yen.

tools.description: Get a single-use checkout link for one of your carts. A person opens it in a browser within 30 minutes; the cart becomes theirs and they complete checkout and payment on the store site. This tool never places an order or takes payment details.

tools.description: Read the status of an order one of your drafts placed: fulfilment status, grand total, and the shipment facts (carrier, tracking number, delivery time) once they exist. Orders placed any other way are not visible here. Requires an orders:read or orders:write key.

order_id.description:
The order id, from `get_order_draft` once its
draft is consumed.

tools.name: get_order_status

carrier.description: Delivery carrier code, once shipped with one named.

delivered_at.description:
When the order was delivered, RFC 3339, when it
has been.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number, once shipped with one.

The product's rating as exposed to agents: the live reviews
aggregate. `average` is null when the product has no
reviews — the API reports the honest aggregate and never
invents one.

average.description: Average rating rounded to one decimal; null at 0 reviews.

count.description: Number of reviews behind the average.

slug.description: Stable ASCII identifier (the agent's matching key).

One purchasable combination of a product, as exposed to

label.description:
Combination label, e.g. `サイズ: M / カラー: ブラック`;
empty for the default variant of a plain product.

price_yen.description:
The combination's price in integer yen: its own price
when it has one, else the product's effective price.

purchasable.description:
Whether this combination can be bought right now,

stock.description: Units in stock for this combination.

allow_backorder.description: Whether the product can be ordered beyond its stock.

path.description: Storefront path of the product page.
